test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the sentence that has the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Kill two birds with one stone

options.text: Today’s fishing session was a success as both the fishermen were working together.
He was so unlucky that he never won a single coin toss in the entire tournament.
Maya decided to clean the house but at the end of the day, she realised it was a great workout.
He ruined his chances of getting into college as he got distracted while studying for two different entrance tests and not perfecting even a single one.

solution: The correct answer is "**Maya decided to clean the house but at the end of the day, she realised it was a great workout."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Kill two birds with one stone means to achieve two aims or results with a single action or effort. (एक पत्थर से दो शिकार) • **Example:** She killed two birds with one stone by using her commute as an opportunity to listen to educational podcasts. • Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 3". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • The other options do not correctly represent the idiom's meaning of accomplishing two tasks with one action. 110:T96d,
